consequence.statement: Strimzi now performs Kafka Connect health checks against the new Kafka Connect health check endpoint; the changelog states no failure, rejection, or required operator action.

original.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 adopts a new Kafka Connect health check endpoint (per proposal 89), changing the endpoint used for Kafka Connect health checks; the previous endpoint and any version or configuration conditions are not stated by the evidence.

decision.reason: [ev-da7ff24b2c60] says only that Strimzi 0.46.0 adopted a new Kafka Connect health check endpoint. That is a change in how the operator runs health checks, but nothing says anything fails, is rejected or needs operator action. This change is also missing from the 0.46.0 upgrade notes, which list the steps operators must take (e.g. [ev-4c2676e4665a], [ev-87094cfdd770], [ev-17b3774eb9ee]). So a low-severity behavior-change (review, not mandatory work) is the strongest consequence the evidence supports, and the proposed statement does not over-claim.
